producer_report.summary: Added the PR #9 squash f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 to `[history] exempt` in athena.toml. The three existing entries are unchanged. I added a comment, decision D70 and a CHANGELOG entry, each giving the reason: most of PR #9's jobs predate athena.candidate/2, so the D69 chain rule cannot link them. D70 cites D60, D67, D68 and D69, and OP-11 appears nowhere. No code changed. `cargo test --locked` passes. I did not run fmt or clippy, since no Rust changed.

checks_run.note: All tests passed, including config::tests::history_exemptions_must_be_full_commit_ids and the repository config parse test.

open_issues: I could not check that f2a8453... is a real commit in history. D60 requires that, and the history check will fail if the id is wrong.
